facts.label: legend
facts.quote: That work also records the anecdote of some verses attributed to Hanuman being discovered by a merchant in Bhoja's reign, engraved upon some rocks on the sea-shore...
facts.text: Popular medieval accounts claim that during the 11th-century CE reign of King Bhoja of Dhara, stone fragments containing verses attributed to Hanuman were recovered from the sea.

facts.label: scripture
facts.quote: The Hanumannataka is a Mahanataka—a fourteen-act Sanskrit drama dealing with the story of Rama and Hanumat...
facts.text: The Sanskrit play Hanumannataka is a 14-act drama compiled by court poet Damodara Mishra under the patronage of King Bhoja.

facts.label: scripture
facts.quote: Valmiki questioned Narada about the most virtuous person on earth, and Narada responded by summarizing the entire life and virtues of Rama.
facts.text: In the opening chapter of the Valmiki Ramayana, sage Narada recites a concise 100-verse summary of Rama's virtues and life, known as the Samkshepa Ramayana, to Valmiki.

facts.label: archaeology
facts.quote: This volume deals with a 250-metre long brick tank which is a unique tank complex of early historical period unearthed there along with associated finds...
facts.text: Between 1977 and 1986, the Archaeological Survey of India excavated the Ramayana-associated site of Sringaverapura, unearthing a 250-metre-long fired-brick hydraulic tank complex dating back to the late first century BCE.

facts.label: archaeology
facts.quote: The plinth itself bore mouldings and frieze panels depicting scenes from the Ramayana, Mahabharata, Vishnu Purana as well as various mithuna scenes.
facts.text: Field excavations and surveys by the Archaeological Survey of India at the Dashavatara Temple in Deogarh confirmed stone narrative friezes depicting Ramayana scenes dating to circa 500 CE.

facts.label: archaeology
facts.quote: The oldest known copy of the Ramayana is a Nepalese palm-leaf edition that dates from the eleventh century.
facts.source_name: National Archives, Kathmandu / Cecil Bendall Collection
facts.text: The oldest surviving physical manuscript of the Valmiki Ramayana discovered in Nepal bears a colophon date of Samvat 1076, corresponding to circa 1020 CE.

facts.label: disputed
facts.quote: It is observed that quotes from the books of Anandavardhana, Rajasekhara and Dhananjaya are there in the Hanumannataka.
facts.source_name: The Sanskrit Drama (A.B. Keith) / Hanumannataka Critical Study
facts.text: Literary historians dispute whether the text of the Mahanataka preserves a genuine archaic oral drama or represents an 11th-century CE anthology that incorporated verses from earlier classical dramatists such as Rajasekhara and Bhavabhuti.

facts.label: scripture
facts.quote: Ma nishada pratishtham tvam agamah sasvatih samah / yat kraunchamithunad ekam avadhih kamamohitam
facts.text: The Valmiki Ramayana records that Valmiki first conceived the epic sloka meter after watching the grief of a krauncha bird following the death of its mate.

facts.label: archaeology
facts.quote: Recently, a central advisory board on archaeology, functioning under the Archaeological Survey of India, approved the project proposal submitted by CSIR – National Institute of Oceanography (NIO), Goa to study the sediments and determine its origin.
facts.text: In 2021, the Archaeological Survey of India approved an underwater scientific research project proposed by the CSIR-National Institute of Oceanography to analyze sediment layers and the formation history of the submerged shoals between India and Sri Lanka.
